CREATE TABLE reservations (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                restaurant_id INTEGER,
                date TEXT,
                time TEXT,
                party_size INTEGER,
                special_requests TEXT,
                confirmation_code TEXT,
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'confirmed',
                slot_id INTEGER,
                cancellation_reason TEXT,
                cancelled_at TEXT,
                modified_at TEXT,
                honored_at TEXT,
                reward_points_awarded INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                reward_awarded_at TEXT,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (restaurant_id) REFERENCES restaurants(id),
                FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES slot_inventory(id)
            );
CREATE INDEX idx_reservations_user ON reservations(user_email, date);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_reservations_active_uniq
    ON reservations(user_email, restaurant_id, date, time)
    WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'waitlisted')
  ;

CREATE TABLE orders (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                restaurant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                date TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'delivered',
                subtotal REAL NOT NULL,
                tax REAL NOT NULL,
                service_fee REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                tip REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                delivery_fee REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.99,
                total REAL NOT NULL,
                delivery_address TEXT,
                items TEXT NOT NULL,
                placed_at TEXT,
                fulfillment_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'delivery',
                promo_code TEXT,
                promo_discount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                credits_applied REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                dashpass_applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                dashpass_savings REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                tip_amount REAL,
                tip_adjusted_at TEXT,
                delivered_at TEXT
            , scheduled_for TEXT, cancelled_at TEXT, order_note TEXT, payment_method_id TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user ON orders(user_email);

content.thinking: Now let me query both databases to get the top 5 restaurants for reservations and top 5 for delivery orders.

input.command:
# Top 5 restaurants by reservation count for Michael Scott
sqlite3 /data/tablefind.sqlite "
SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM reservations res
JOIN restaurants r ON res.restaurant_id = r.id
WHERE res.user_email = 'michael.scott@dundermifflin.com'
GROUP BY r.name
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 5;
"

# Top 5 restaurants by delivery order count for Michael Scott
sqlite3 /data/hangrydash.sqlite "
SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM orders o
JOIN restaurants r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id
WHERE o.user_email = 'michael.scott@dundermifflin.com'
GROUP BY r.name
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 5;
"

# Total counts
echo "=== Total Reservations ==="
sqlite3 /data/tablefind.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE user_email = 'michael.scott@dundermifflin.com';"
echo "=== Total Delivery Orders ==="
sqlite3 /data/hangrydash.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_email = 'michael.scott@dundermifflin.com';"
